cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; absent when no further replies are known.

limit.description: Maximum number of replies to return.

subject.description: AT-URI of the review whose replies to list — a community.lexicon.media.book.review record.

description: List the replies to one review, oldest first. Replies are public records in their authors' own repos, discovered by the review they name in `subject` — no per-author fan-out. Each reply carries the reactions naming it so a reaction bar needs no second call; a page deeper than 20 replies ships none.
